title: Khichri (Basmati Rice with Red Lentils)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Rice and red lentils cooked together: the author's ultimate comfort food and the easiest thing to make in a rush. Goes with almost any meat or vegetable dish, or plain with raita or chutney; especially good with kababs.

steps.action: Rinse in a large bowl until the water runs almost clear (removes starch that makes grains stick); drain well:
Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and stir about 1 min, until the cumin darkens slightly:
Add and fry, stirring occasionally, 5 to 8 min, until medium brown:
items: 1 medium onion (8 oz / 225 g), quartered and thinly sliced

steps.action: Add rice and daal; stir once. Add, stir well, and bring to a boil:
Cover tightly; cook on low (2/10) exactly 26 min. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 min. Never lift the lid while cooking.
